node.title: Re^3: No tools? Use Perl?!
node.author: Boyd.Ako
node.doctext:
The regexp needs the /g switch or the code will loop forever, and you use $1 but don't have capturing groups.
I don't know the specifics as to how /g works. All I know is that in other scripts I've wrote it stops at the first instance. Considering that I have multiple sections I don't think it will work and thus am assuming that is what I want. I haven't set up $1 captures yet because it should only have one thing being feed to it; the file. I'll work on error handling for invalid input later.
